thread:
release-bot: Opening deploy window for search-llm v1.8.0. Planned feature flag ramp: `search.llm.v1.slowvalve` 0% -> 2% -> 10% over 30m. Change window 01:30-03:30 UTC. Paging @kate @ryan.

kate: ack. I'll watch p50/p95 and 5xx. runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/search-llm/v1.8.0

ryan: request emergency pin rules: auto-pin if 5xx >1.2% for 4m OR p95 +300ms. Also prefer disabling large-quant shard on first step.

priya: good call. will enable verbose sampling on canary. I'll run a small A/B eval for semantic drift.

ops-bot: preflight checks OK: infra healthy, replica lag 0.2s, GPU headroom 30%. Alert rule armed to DM @ryan on sustained error rate.

kate: toggling to 2% now:
```
/redwood flag set --name search.llm.v1.slowvalve --pct 2 --who kate --note "step1 slow valve"
```

ryan: metrics after 8m: p95 from 190ms -> 210ms, 5xx steady. holding at 2% for 12m.

priya: canary eval green. no semantic regressions. recommend move to 10% after hold.

kate: advancing to 10% in 3m.

ops-bot: at 02:14 observed 5xx spike to 1.6% for 3.5m. paging ryan.

ryan: I see the spike, investigating traces t-77, t-79. Looks like a downstream cache write race. Manual pin to v1.7.6 executed to stop ramp:
```
/release pin --service search-llm --version v1.7.6 --who ryan --reason "error spike during ramp"
```

release-bot: Pin recorded at 8476543238 by ryan. Rolling cohorts back to v1.7.6; draining v1.8.0. Posting short note to #release-notes: "v1.8.0 ramp halted at 10% due to elevated 5xx; pinned to v1.7.6 while infra investigates."

priya: filing bug with traces and sample inputs; assigning infra-cache.

kate: agreed hold on reattempt until cache fix + 24h staging soak. marking release ticket. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
